Derive ecDNA intervals from an AmpliconArchitect cycles file

Source: R/episomal_ampliconsuite.R
aa_cycle_intervals.Rd

Generalises call_episomal_from_ampliconsuite() to any AmpliconArchitect output, including bare AA runs without AmpliconClassifier. The ecDNA extent is taken from the reconstructed cycle: the segments of the dominant (highest Copy_count) cycle, or of all cycles. The AA "source" vertex (segment id 0) is dropped. Returned coordinates use the exclusive-end convention of the AmpliconClassifier BED, so the result plugs straight into the intervals argument of call_episomal_from_ampliconsuite().

Usage

aa_cycle_intervals(cycles_file, cycle = c("dominant", "all"))

Arguments

cycles_file

Path to an AmpliconArchitect *_cycles.txt.

cycle

Which cycle(s) to use: "dominant" (default, highest copy count) or "all".

Value

A data.table::data.table of chr, start, end (exclusive end), or NULL if no usable cycle/segments are found.

See also

call_episomal_from_ampliconsuite(), read_ampliconsuite()
